## Phase 0: Environment Setup

Install packages once, then load libraries each session.

```{r packages}
# Run once, then comment this line:
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "caret", "GGally", "corrplot", "car", "MASS", "lmtest", "pROC", "rpart", "randomForest"))

library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(GGally)
library(corrplot)
library(car)
library(MASS)
library(lmtest)
library(pROC)
library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
```

## Phase 1: Data Understanding

Load the dataset and inspect structure, missingness, and target balance.

```{r load-data}
loan_df <- read.csv("loan_data.csv")

dim(loan_df)
str(loan_df)
summary(loan_df)
colSums(is.na(loan_df))
prop.table(table(loan_df$loan_status))
```

## Notes

Write findings after each phase before moving to modeling.
